description: This file defines an abstract class 'AmqpCliClient' which provides methods for connecting to an AMQP adapter and creating senders, used as part of a CLI client for interacting with Hono's AMQP component.

classes.name: AmqpCliClient
classes.description: Abstract class providing connection and sender creation functionality for AMQP interactions in a CLI context.

methods.name: setClientConfig
methods.description: Sets configuration properties for connecting to the AMQP adapter.

methods.name: createSender
methods.description: Creates an anonymous sender link on an established connection.

methods.name: connectToAdapter
methods.description: Connects to the AMQP adapter and returns a future for the connection.

methods.name: addTlsTrustOptions
methods.description: Configures TLS trust options on the client options based on provided configuration.
